headline: MSCI Consults Indonesian President Prabowo to Discuss Market Status Downgrade Concerns
summary: MSCI Chief Executive Henry Fernandez met with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto to evaluate options regarding the country's market classification. MSCI had previously warned it might downgrade Indonesia's emerging market status.
why: MSCI index classifications determine global institutional asset allocations, with potential downgrades triggering significant capital outflows.

impacts.name: IDX Composite
impacts.why: Discussions to avoid an MSCI index downgrade reduce foreign divestment risks for Indonesian equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Indonesian market sentiment improved after news that MSCI is open to avoiding a market classification downgrade.
